summary: Fix Server-Sent Events endpoints (e.g. /api/notifications/stream) returning HTTP 500 'streaming unsupported' and the browser EventSource reconnecting in a loop. The request-log/api-activity-log statusWriter wrapper embedded the http.ResponseWriter interface and so hid the concrete writer's Flush; it now implements http.Flusher by forwarding Flush to the underlying writer
compatibility: Shared middleware fix; benefits every app's streaming endpoints. No API or behavior change for non-streaming requests.
